name: Common Stone
description: A simple stone. Even a dragon's hoard has filler.

name: Tarnished Coin
description: Old currency of a forgotten kingdom, still warm to the touch.

name: Cracked Gemstone
description: Flawed, but it still catches the firelight nicely.

name: Rusted Pauldron
description: A knight's shoulder-guard. The kobolds find it inspiring.

name: Rare Ruby
description: A ruby that glimmers with a fiery glow.

name: Silver Chalice
description: A ceremonial cup worth a small fortune.

name: Jade Idol
description: A carved figure the kobolds revere; they work harder near it.

name: Moonstone Ring
description: It sharpens the senses — and the claws.

name: Mystic Sapphire
description: A sapphire that holds the secrets of the universe.

name: Enchanted Amulet
description: An amulet that grants the wearer protection and luck.

name: Obsidian Crown
description: A crown of volcanic glass, heavy with old authority.

name: Dragonbone Relic
description: A shard of an ancestor's wing. The brood snaps to attention.

name: Starlit Orb
description: Captured starlight that whispers of greater hoards to come.

name: Ancient Golden Goblet
description: A goblet that shines with the light of a thousand suns.

name: Philosopher's Hoard
description: A vault-in-a-box that quietly multiplies whatever it touches.

name: Worldheart Diamond
description: The single greatest gem ever unearthed. Kingdoms would burn for it.

name: Bent Copper Key
description: It opens nothing anymore, but the kobolds pocket the coppers all the same.

name: Mossy Skull
description: A previous treasure-hunter. A cautionary ornament for the hoard.

name: Amber Pendant
description: A bead of ancient sap with an insect frozen mid-flight inside.

name: Ivory Warhorn
description: One blast and the whole brood digs twice as hard.

name: Frost Opal
description: It fogs the air with cold and reveals paths the eye would miss.

name: Emberglass Vial
description: Molten light sealed in glass, warm against a mountain of coin.

name: Runed Gauntlet
description: Every strike lands heavier when the old runes catch the firelight.

name: Phoenix Feather
description: Still smoldering. It whispers of hoards reborn greater than before.

name: Crown of Ages
description: Worn by every dragon-king in turn. The brood labors for its favor.

name: Sunfire Scepter
description: A rod of caged daylight; the hoard grows even as it sleeps.

name: Void Pearl
description: A black sphere that swallows light and gives back only secrets.

name: Heart of the Mountain
description: The living ember at the world's root. Every coin you own runs hotter.

name: Wyrmfire Ruby
description: A gem that burns with a dead dragon's greed, and never cools.

name: Astral Hoardstone
description: It remembers every hoard you have ever burned, and pays the memory forward.

name: Titanforged Idol
description: Cast by giants for a god of avarice. The brood works itself to legend before it.

name: Crown of Avarice
description: To wear it is to want everything, forever. Conveniently, everything pays more.

name: Eye of the Wyrm
description: The last sight of the eldest dragon, still hungry, still counting.

name: Worldforge Core
description: The furnace at the center of creation. Gold is merely what it exhales.

name: Embercrown
description: A circlet of everburning coals, worn only by wyrms who have outlived kingdoms.

name: Genesis Shard
description: A splinter of the first morning. Hold it and every coin remembers how to multiply.
